SELECT 
    qi.id as quote_item_id,
    qi.total as total_presupuesto,
    COALESCE(SUM(ii.total), 0) as ya_facturado,
    (qi.total - COALESCE(SUM(ii.total), 0)) as saldo_disponible
FROM quote_items qi
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.quote_item_id = qi.id
LEFT JOIN invoice_items ii ON ii.order_item_id = oi.id
WHERE qi.id IN ({{ $json.items.map(i => i.quote_item_id).join(',') }})
GROUP BY qi.id, qi.total;

WITH quote_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    q.id as quote_id,
    q.total as total_presupuesto,
    COALESCE(SUM(ii.total), 0) as total_facturado
  FROM public.quotes q
  JOIN public.orders o ON o.quote_id = q.id
  JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  LEFT JOIN public.invoice_items ii ON ii.order_item_id = oi.id
  WHERE q.id = $1
  GROUP BY q.id, q.total
)
UPDATE public.quotes 
SET 
  billing_status = CASE 
    WHEN qs.total_facturado = 0 THEN 'not_invoiced'
    WHEN qs.total_facturado < qs.total_presupuesto THEN 'partially_invoiced'
    ELSE 'invoiced'
  END,
  updated_at = NOW()
FROM quote_summary qs
WHERE public.quotes.id = qs.quote_id
RETURNING public.quotes.id, public.quotes.billing_status;
